# Inference proofs

> An open benchmark for provable inference on open-weights models.

Systems are compared within one model rung. Passing the six checks does not certify AI safety. Read each system's scope, sample sizes, grades, evidence tiers and source records before citing a result.

The deployment article discusses hypothetical agreements, not an enacted treaty.

- [Proving a forward pass · Inference proofs](https://www.inferenceproofs.ai/forward-pass): The verifier tests the prover's committed values at random points. Matrix products with the committed weights are the cheap part to prove.
  - [Testing a product at random](https://www.inferenceproofs.ai/forward-pass#testing-a-product-at-random)
  - [Fiat-Shamir](https://www.inferenceproofs.ai/forward-pass#fiat-shamir)

- [How a check works · Inference proofs](https://www.inferenceproofs.ai/how-a-check-works): One request for every system, a commitment, a proof and a verifier without the weights, six checks drawn one by one, and the fraction behind the headline figure.

- [How we compare · Inference proofs](https://www.inferenceproofs.ai/method): Every system gets the same request. Those passing the six checks, with a stated security level, are ranked by cost vs serving inside one model.

- [What a proof shows · Inference proofs](https://www.inferenceproofs.ai/proof-of-inference): A proof shows a reply is the committed model's greedy reply to its prompt, not whose model it is or that the reply was served.
  - [Outside the proof](https://www.inferenceproofs.ai/proof-of-inference#outside-the-proof)
  - [Today's systems](https://www.inferenceproofs.ai/proof-of-inference#today-s-systems)
  - [Passed](https://www.inferenceproofs.ai/proof-of-inference#passed)
- [SASH · Inference proofs](https://www.inferenceproofs.ai/sash): SASH on Llama 3.1 8B Instruct, passed. Cost vs serving: 62,160×.

- [The statement · Inference proofs](https://www.inferenceproofs.ai/statement): The ladder's verifiers check a committed, quantized copy's greedy reply. No row has a proved error bound that covers what it runs.
  - [Each system's statement](https://www.inferenceproofs.ai/statement#each-system-s-statement)
